# Spinne Software

> Every product leaves machinery behind. Desktop software, local AI, and the cloud systems underneath. Sparkle is the first.

Spinne Software makes its own software instead of taking contracts. It is one engineer in Rome, and the order of the work is deliberate: build the machinery once, then build the products that stand on it.

## Pages

- [Spinne Software](https://spinnesoftware.com/): Spinne Software builds its own products all the way down: GPU rendering, local AI, metered cloud, Italian e-invoicing. Sparkle is the first.
- [A video editor with an engine under it](https://spinnesoftware.com/sparkle/): Sparkle is a desktop video editor: GPU rendering shared by preview and export, AI on your own machine, hardware encoding. In private preview.
- [Where the editor ends and the model begins](https://spinnesoftware.com/how-we-build/): How Sparkle is built: one document, one set of operations on it, and an assistant that is another caller rather than another program.
- [A technology company that ships](https://spinnesoftware.com/about/): Spinne Software builds its own products rather than taking contracts. Legal identity, what exists, and the diligence answers including the ones that are no.
- [Privacy — Spinne Software](https://spinnesoftware.com/privacy/): How spinnesoftware.com handles personal data. No cookies, no analytics, no third-party services, nothing sold or shared.
